policy.window_rule: The already exercised 0.0.20 product is the sole compatibility window. A retained public compatibility route is explicit-only, non-authoritative, warning-bearing, and incapable of claim promotion.
policy.removal_rule: Version 0.0.21 may retire the legacy authority and compatibility route only after N14 proves canonical replacement behavior, route equivalence where promised, zero duplicate authority, rollback, and current inventory binding.
policy.durable_state_rule: Historical serialized bytes may retain a read-only migration reader when current evidence proves a durable-state obligation; the reader cannot write, select, or promote authority.
policy.physical_cleanup_rule: OD-008 authorizes compatibility timing only. Physical deletion remains governed by OD-009 and exact path/content authority.

required_n14_evidence: promised compatibility equivalence or an explicit unsupported disposition
rollback or preserved historical-reader behavior where required
current 0.0.21 package version binding before release
prohibited_inferences: No route is retired merely because this decision exists.
No physical deletion is authorized by this decision.
No historical reader may regain write or selection authority.
No package, install, discovery, runtime, journey, readiness, release, or completion claim is promoted.
claim_ceiling: OD-008 decided; N14 reobservation and implementation are eligible. All product and release claims remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This record resolves compatibility timing. It is not migration implementation, route-equivalence, retirement, package, runtime, or release proof.
